method: facebook/wav2vec2-large-960h-lv60-self CTC forced alignment of Lyrics (Suno).txt to production/stems/vocals.mp3, checked against faster-whisper large-v3
notes: start is when the word's first letter is heard, to about 20-40 ms. end is when its last letter is recognised; a held vowel can ring on past it.
confidence is the mean log-probability of the word's letters: near 0 is a clean match, below about -3 is doubtful.
whisper is true when Whisper independently heard the word within 1.2 s of its start; for a line, it's the fraction of its words. Check a line with low confidence or low whisper by ear.
A word with a note was moved to an earlier take: the vocal repeats it (an echo or delay throw) and the alignment had landed on the repeat.
'bar' uses the grid in song.json: bar 0 is the first drop.
